summary: Iteration 7 (frontend only). Verified app loads at public URL with 0 console/page errors, main 3-panel layout renders, all toolbar controls present, source/destination panels show 'Not connected' with clickable Open buttons (pick-source-btn/pick-dest-btn). Regressions re-verified: Settings modal opens, Cancel discards changes (template + Copy/Move mode revert correctly), Shortcuts (help-modal) opens and closes with Escape, Category manager opens/closes cleanly, compare-1 works (compare-2/3 correctly disabled with no images). The real pick->auto-select->store->badge flow could not be exercised because the File System Access API directory picker cannot be automated (as noted by the dev agent).

integration_issues.issue: POSSIBLE RACE (static analysis only, not runtime-reproducible): in TreeNode the refreshCounter effect only calls load(true) when `open && branchHasStore` is true in that render. Because justStored and destRefreshCounter are updated in the same React 18 batch, a branch that was collapsed but had previously loaded children may run the refreshCounter effect while `open` is still false; the subsequent auto-expand only triggers load(false), which returns early since children !== null. Result: newly-created subfolders may not appear for a collapsed-then-expanded ancestor. Suggest keying the force reload on [refreshCounter, open] or clearing children (setChildren(null)) when refreshCounter changes and branchHasStore.

action_items: Consider fixing the TreeNode refreshCounter/open ordering race described above (force reload should also fire when the branch opens after a store).
Optional: reset justStored (and badges) when the user picks a new destination root in pickDest to avoid unbounded accumulation of stale path keys.
critical_code_review_comments: App.js pickSource calls onSelectSourceFolder (declared later via useCallback) — works today since the call happens after mount, but it relies on TDZ timing; consider declaring onSelectSourceFolder above pickSource for clarity.
App.js is 1159 lines — exceeds the 700-line guideline; consider extracting the toolbar/modals into modules.
